newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume drops, prices fall.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume drops, prices fall.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange fell sharply to 470 kg on Monday from 1,639 kg on Friday, as prices fell in line with world trends and traders were sidelined expecting further price falls, dealers said.
Gold closed at $344.50 an ounce and 1,289,400 lira per grammes, down from Friday's $346.50 and 1,294,100.
Dealers said downward world prices and weak gold demand in the free market dragged down lira prices, despite the lira weakening against the dollar.
The Turkish currency eased to 116,500 lira to the dollar from 115,800 on Friday.
All of the day's trade occurred in the morning session. 76.6 percent of the total trade was in lira terms.
